6990.title: Transient upstream failures overwrite Claude session affinity
6990.rootCauseOneLine: Successful fallback commits a new affinity binding because routing tracks attempted accounts but does not distinguish transient upstream failure from account rejection.

prReviews.topFinding: The open linked PR distinguishes transient failures and adds bounded retries; its branch was not checked out or run.

6990.proposedFix: Distinguish transient failures from account-specific refusals, retry the pinned account with bounded cancellable backoff, and preserve its affinity during a transient detour.
6990.caveats: Synthetic upstream at the real plugin HTTP boundary, repeated in a second clean checkout. Live provider failures and cache billing were not measured. No duplicate fix PR: open PR #6991 already closes this issue.
